keywords: 协议简洁性是无需信任的关键
L1 TPS 超过所有 validium 与 optimium
多个 EIP 被标记 stagnant
summary: 周日较安静。VitalikButerin 强调协议简洁性是无需信任、通过离场测试与自主权中常被低估的一环。Magicians 讨论把授权视为执行之下缺失的一层状态。donnoh_eth 指出以太坊 L1 的 TPS 持续超过所有 validium 与 optimium 之和。

items.title: Magicians：在以太坊中把授权与执行分离
items.note: （recurmj）05:51：主张授权是执行之下缺失的一层机器状态，许可式拉取是唯一正确尊重这一层的金融执行语义。
items.title_en: Magicians: Separating Authorization from Execution in Ethereum
items.note_en: (recurmj), 05:51: argues authorization is a missing layer of machine state beneath execution, and permissioned pull is the only financial execution semantics that respects it.

keywords_en: Protocol simplicity as a key to trustlessness
L1 TPS above all validiums and optimiums combined
summary_en: A quiet Sunday. VitalikButerin stressed protocol simplicity as an underrated part of trustlessness, the walkaway test and self sovereignty. A Magicians post framed authorization as a missing layer of state beneath execution. donnoh_eth noted Ethereum L1 consistently does more TPS than all validiums and optimiums combined.
